description: Dashboard for Grafana K6 load test monitoring, troubleshooting and reporting. As concise and minimal as possible, whilst including critical data points. It includes metrics for both Protocol (http_...) and Browser (browser_...) tests. It includes Groups (Transactions) for protocol level testing.

targets.query: SELECT count("value") as "Count", min("value") as "Min", mean("value") as "Avg", percentile("value", 75) as "p75", percentile("value", 90) as "p90", percentile("value", 95) as "p95", percentile("value", 99) as "p99", max("value") as "Max" FROM group_duration WHERE $timeFilter AND "testName" =~ /^$Test_Name$/ GROUP BY "group"

SELECT sum("value") as "Errors"
FROM http_req_failed
WHERE $timeFilter AND "testName" =~ /^$Test_Name$/
GROUP BY "group"

SELECT
  count("value") as "Count",
  min("value") as "Min",
  mean("value") as "Avg",
  max("value") as "Max",
  percentile("value", 75) as "p75",
  percentile("value", 90) as "p90",
  percentile("value", 95) as "p95",
  percentile("value", 99) as "p99"
FROM http_req_duration
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND "testName" =~ /^$Test_Name$/
GROUP BY "group", "name", "method"

SELECT
  sum("value") AS "Failed Requests"
FROM "http_req_failed"
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND "testName" =~ /^$Test_Name$/
GROUP BY "name"

SELECT sum("value") AS "Passed"
FROM "checks"
WHERE $timeFilter
AND "testName" =~ /^$Test_Name$/
GROUP BY "group","check"

SELECT count("value") AS "Total"
FROM "checks"
WHERE $timeFilter
AND "testName" =~ /^$Test_Name$/
GROUP BY "group","check"
SELECT "group", "method", "name", "status", "error_code", "value" FROM "http_req_failed" WHERE $timeFilter AND "testName" =~ /^$Test_Name$/ AND error_code != ''

SELECT count("value") AS "Total Requests"
FROM "http_req_duration"
WHERE $timeFilter
AND "testName" =~ /^$Test_Name$/
GROUP BY "group","name","method"

SELECT sum("value") AS "Failed Requests"
FROM "http_req_failed"
WHERE $timeFilter
AND "testName" =~ /^$Test_Name$/
GROUP BY "group","name","method"
